source_binding.method: Checkout source paths are verified against exact Git blobs at revision; external evidence/artifacts/tools are hashed live.

limits: Validity is separate from the performance goal. Inspect performance_target.all_four_below_two.
All ratios use complete-process medians. Empty controls are not subtracted and omit nonempty parsing/alignment.
Measured orders are balanced; eight warmups and cross-round transitions are not fully balanced.
Callgrind counts guest instructions, not CPU cycles or wall-time speedup. Inclusive edges overlap.
DHAT requested bytes/blocks are not RSS; two-count allocation slopes do not prove linearity.
No engines, application oracles, builds, timing runs, or profiles were executed by this auditor.
